objectives.description: Add ADVISORY (not FAIL) lane for core never-deployed scripts
Add provides.hooks drift/completeness check for core
Verify additivity (memory extension unaffected) and unchanged ordinary-invocation verdict

deviations.description: check-extension-docs.sh: treat 'not deployed' as FAIL for the core extension
deviations.reason: The orchestrator's delegation instructions imposed a binding guardrail after the plan was written: the pre-existing core deploy drift is REAL right now and can only be resolved by a user-driven manual regeneration; a hard FAIL would brick this doc-lint gate for every caller until then, including a concurrently-running sibling session validating an unrelated memory-extension manifest change via this same script. Implemented as a new ADVISORY lane (advisory() function, DEPLOY_DRIFT_ADVISORIES counter, dedicated always-visible summary section) that is always printed (ignoring --quiet) but never affects FAILURES or the exit code by default. An opt-in STRICT_CORE_DEPLOY=1 env var promotes the same advisories to real fail()-driven failures for a future post-regeneration verification run.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — ADVISORY lane instead of a hard FAIL, per binding orchestrator guardrail; see check_core_deploy_advisory's in-file rationale comment)*
